ov: ملائكة الشيطان (الفرنسية: Les Anges de Satan) هو فيلم مغربي أخرجه أحمد بولان سنة 2007.
plotEn: The Satanic Angels is the story of fourteen young hard rock musicians who are arrested and sentenced to three months to one year in jail for "shaking the foundations of Islam" and "Satanism" after a surrealistic trial. Society and the media mobilize to free them.
